evidence.quote: Whenever I am asked what policies and initiatives could do the most to spur economic growth and raise living standards, improving education is at the top of my list.

When successful, monetary policy can be a powerful and effective tool to these ends, but its capabilities are dwarfed by larger factors such as the productivity of the workforce and the strength of household finances.

parsed.rationale: These welcoming remarks to teachers concern economic education and Fed outreach programs. They offer no view on rates, inflation, the labor market or the balance sheet, so the stance is neutral.
